definitions.explanation: Being completely focused on one thing or one person with unwavering dedication. Often used positively, especially about love, passion, or effort.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一途|いちず}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{愛|あい}している→愛する：01811_aisuru⟧。
{一途|いちず}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集中|しゅうちゅう}する→集中する：21908_shuuchuusuru⟧。
examples.english: She has a single-minded personality and concentrates on one thing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かって→向かう：01186_mukau⟧{一途|いちず}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}して→努力する：20201_doryokusuru⟧きた⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、ついに⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{達成|たっせい}した→達成する：22183_tasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: As a result of working single-mindedly toward his dream, he finally achieved his goal.

notes:
USAGE:
Generally a positive quality, especially in romantic contexts where it means being devoted to one person. Can occasionally carry a nuance of being inflexible or blindly focused.

FORMS:
- {一途|いちず}な + noun (devoted; single-minded)
- {一途|いちず}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb (wholeheartedly; single-mindedly)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一途|いちず}な⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧ (devoted love)
- {一途|いちず}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a devoted person)
- {一途|いちず}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧ (to think of someone devotedly)
- {一途|いちず}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{打|う}ち{込|こ}む→打ち込む：04229_uchikomu⟧ (to devote oneself single-mindedly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ひたむき→ひたむき：10492_hitamuki⟧: earnest; single-minded — emphasizes putting in effort with dedication, often about work or study
- ⟦{一心|いっしん}→一心：11236_isshin⟧: single-hearted — more literary, focuses on concentrated mental effort
